review_bodies.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]
review_bodies.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended Execution-time OSErrors are incorrectly treated as missing executables, causing misleading Docker installation messages, inappropriate Compose fallback, and loss of the original diagnostics.
2 open issues - [Restrict compose fallback to FileNotFoundError](https://github.com/dancing-bear-show/dancing-bear/pull/473#discussion_r4487598144) · New - [Treat only FileNotFoundError as a missing Docker executable](https://github.com/dancing-bear-show/dancing-bear/pull/473#discussion_r4487598216) · New
What changed in this PR This refactor replaces duplicated helper logic in telemetry, worker, and workflow code with shared implementations, while improving handling of missing Docker binaries and Compose fallback timeouts. **Changes:** - Adopt `core.process.run_binary` for collector commands and update tests, including fallback-timeout coverage. - Share stage-file loading and time-window filtering between telemetry reports. - Replace local UTC timestamp logic with `now_utc()` and `iso_now()`. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tests/​telemetry_tests/​test_collector.py | Use `CompletedRun` fixtures and cover plugin fallback timeouts. | | tests/​telemetry_tests/​otel_cli/​test_workflow_cost.py | Update tests for the renamed stage loader. | | src/​workflow/​sweep_record.py | Replace the local timestamp helper with `iso_now()`. | | src/​worker/​queue_ops.py | Use `now_utc()` for queue timing operations. | | src/​worker/​queue_metrics.py | Use `now_utc()` for status metrics. | | src/​worker/​job_runtime.py | Use `now_utc()` when checking stale jobs. | | src/​worker/​commands.py | Use `now_utc()` for throughput-log date selection. | | src/​worker/​_helpers.py | Use `now_utc()` for performance-log timestamps. | | src/​telemetry/​otel/​cli/​workflow_cost.py | Expose the stage loader for cross-module reuse. | | src/​telemetry/​otel/​cli/​otel_summary.py | Reuse stage loading and time-window filtering. | | src/​telemetry/​collector.py | Replace direct subprocess calls with `run_binary`. |
Review effort: Balanced
